title: 第152章 惊艳出场
slug: 电竞世界冠军选秀c位出道
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

台下的观众握紧手中的应援物，屏住呼吸看着漆黑一片的舞台。

贵宾区的VaX缓缓挺直腰板，眼睛眨也不眨地盯着台上，满是新奇。

“现场看江执屿舞台感受很不一样的。”旁边的林石翘着二郎腿幽幽说着。

“林哥，那你是第几次看？”VaX有些好奇地回头看向林石。

林石上扬的嘴角微微一僵，咳嗽两声，小声回答：“第一次。”

舞台上的顶光缓缓亮起，五个身影逐渐显现，一字横排站在舞台中央。

所有人都将注意力放在前场，此时，都不由微微一愣，随即开始交头接耳。

“怎么才五个人？”

“三公不都是六人组吗？”

“还有一个人去哪儿了？”

“临时出意外不能上台了？”

突然，观众席后场的骚动大起。

前排纷纷回头，视线猝不及防撞上此时正站在观众席内场和看台区中央空地上的身影，呼吸都随之一滞。

直播镜头从全景转为近景，并缓缓拉近。

“好惊喜的出场方式。”

林石点了点头，瞥见VaX突然瞪大的眼睛，忍不住看向他。

只见他的双眼死死盯着转播大屏，瞳孔剧烈震颤，嘴巴微微张开。

不知道发生了什么事的林石疑惑地顺着对方的视线看去，看清大屏画面时，也微微愣神。

直播镜头已然逼近站在空地上的江执屿，将对方完整的脸部特写分明呈现在屏幕上。

屏幕中的他，瞳孔漆黑透亮，眼尾微红，侧脸的淡红伤痕和嘴角的红痕在白皙的皮肤上尤为显眼，像有魔力般轻而易举抓住观者的眼。

黑发被抓成湿碎偏分，几缕微湿的发丝贴在颈侧，原本散落在额前的额发此时往后搭着，露出光滑的额头，更将他优越的五官清晰展现。

桃花眼微微下垂，直视稍低的镜头机位，耳麦别在耳后，麦克风搭在唇边，嘴角带着一抹似有若无的笑意。

眼下痣被染红，缀在眼睛下方，像一颗红宝石般耀眼。

现场短暂陷入一片寂静。

不过几秒，巨大的尖叫声响彻整个场馆。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The audience in the audience clenched the cheering objects in their hands and held their breath while looking at the dark stage.

VaX in the VIP area slowly straightened her back and stared at the stage without blinking, full of novelty.

"Watching Jiang Zhiyu's stage live is a very different experience." Lin Shi next to him said quietly with his legs crossed.

"Brother Lin, how many times have you seen this?" VaX looked back at Lin Shi curiously.

Lin Shi's raised corners of his mouth froze slightly, coughed twice, and replied in a low voice: "This is the first time."

The top light on the stage slowly turned on, and five figures gradually appeared, standing in a row in the center of the stage.

Everyone focused their attention on the front court. At this time, they couldn't help being slightly stunned, and then started whispering to each other.

"Why are there only five people?"

"Aren't the three gentlemen a group of six?"

"Where is the other person?"

"Can't go on stage due to a temporary accident?"

Suddenly, there was a commotion in the back of the auditorium.

The front row turned around one after another, and their eyes suddenly caught sight of the figure standing in the open space in the middle of the auditorium and the grandstand area, and their breathing was stagnant.

The live broadcast shot changed from a panoramic view to a close-up shot, and slowly zoomed in.

"What a surprising way to appear."

Lin Shi nodded and caught a glimpse of VaX's suddenly widened eyes, and couldn't help but look at him.

His eyes were fixed on the big broadcast screen, his pupils were trembling violently, and his mouth was slightly open.

Lin Shi, who didn't know what was going on, followed the other person's line of sight in confusion, and was slightly stunned when he saw the big screen clearly.

The live broadcast camera has already approached Jiang Zhiyu, who is standing in the open space, clearly showing the close-up of the other person's face on the screen.

On the screen, he has dark and translucent pupils, slightly red at the end of his eyes. The reddish scars on the side of his face and the red marks at the corners of his mouth are particularly conspicuous on his fair skin, easily catching the viewer's eyes like magic.

The black hair was pulled into wet pieces and parted sideways, with a few strands of slightly damp hair sticking to the side of his neck. The forehead hair that was originally scattered in front of his forehead was now pulled back, revealing his smooth forehead and clearly showing his superior facial features.

Her peach blossom eyes were slightly drooped, looking directly at the slightly lower camera position, with the headset tucked behind her ears, the microphone placed on her lips, and a faint smile on her lips.

Now the mole is dyed red and decorated under the eye, shining like a ruby.

There was brief silence.

Within seconds, a huge scream echoed throughout the venue.
